title: Breast ultrasound: a third set of lesions proven by biopsy or follow-up
description: Breast ultrasound images from Breast-Lesions-USG (one patient each), every lesion outlined freehand by a radiologist experienced in breast ultrasound who also recorded its BI-RADS descriptors, proven by biopsy or confirmed on follow-up. Every remaining case of the dataset that meets the round-4 rule (one lesion per image, not a scar, implant or duct finding, not a risk lesion), each checked by eye with the outline drawn. Cropped 8-bit B-mode frames with their true pixel size.
